answer: Escrowed Reputation Handoff. Each identity’s earned reputation is locked in a handoff escrow; transferring identity requires the new holder to post collateral equal to half the escrow and wait one full settlement spiral before withdrawal. A cloned identity starts at zero escrow, so every clone pays collateral plus a walnut of unrecoverable lock time per attempt. To scale, an attacker must fund N simultaneous escrows, reaching the summit of exposure where one detected clone forfeits all pledged collateral across the batch, making each marginal clone strictly negative-EV.
